notes: Broader Japanese coverage. The overlay image / video / shape and a few scene controls are now translated too: the X / Y / Size / Width / Height / Rotate / Volume / Radius / Curve / Color / Type / Opacity / Position labels, the shape type buttons (Rect / Square / Circle / Ribbon), Replace / Remove, 'Use as blurred background', the 'Muted' readout, 'per cycle', the free-position label, scene Fade in / Fade out, and the Preview / Mute / clip-handle tooltips all read in Japanese under 日本語. Switching language rebuilds the editor so it updates immediately.
